source_title: Joe Lando Honors One Life to Live at 2026 Daytime Emmys, Says Soaps Are ‘Most Difficult Acting Jobs’ - People.com
source_excerpt:
“It’s probably one of the most difficult acting jobs I’ve ever had,” Lando said of working on daytime television during the 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards on Oct. 30
One Life to Live star Joe Lando presented during the 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards
The 53rd Daytime Emmy Awards were held in Los Angeles on Friday, Oct. 30
Joe Lando attended the 2026 Daytime Emmys to represent the legacy of One Life to Live.
On Friday, Oct. 30, Lando, 64 — who starred as Jake Harrison on One Life to Live — paid tribute to the ABC soap opera at this year’s award ceremony held in Los Angeles.
“When I worked on One Life to Live, I learned just how much hard work goes into daytime drama. It’s probably one of the most difficult acting jobs I’ve ever had,” Lando said. “The sheer amount of dialogue one has to learn is terrifying given the small amount of time you have. Sometimes up to 100 pages a day, and 72 is my personal best.”
“In other genres, some actors might play a role; if they are lucky, they come back six months later,” he continued. “But the people in daytime television, they work their craft every single day. No matter how weird or wild a storyline might sometimes be, that is why I have so much deep respect for every actor in this room tonight.”
“And the craft of acting for daytime is just so unique. It’s so distinct and worthy of admiration. We all work very hard for our audiences because you know what?It’s worth it,” Lando concluded.

He presented the awards for Outstanding Lead Actor in a Daytime Drama Series and Outstanding Daytime Drama alongside Juliet Mills from Passions .
“It’s been an honor to work and present with you,” he said to his fellow daytime television star. “It’s been an honor to reminisce with all of you.”
Robert Milazzo/ABC/Courtesy Everett Collection
One Life to Live debuted in July 1968 and ran for 45 seasons until it concluded in January 2012. The soap opera followed three wealthy families in the fictional small town of Llanview, Pa. — the Lord family, the Buchanan clan, and the Cramer family — as they navigated dramatic rivalries, romances and secrecy.
Lando starred in the hit soap opera from March 1990 to July 1992 alongside Jessica Tuck, who starred as his wife, Megan Gordon Harrison. The two became one of the most beloved couples in soap opera history.
Lando’s appearance at the 2026 Daytime Emmys is part of the ceremony’s tribute to beloved daytime dramas from the past. It was previously announced that Juliet Mills would pay homage to Passions, Crystal Chappell to Guiding Light , Lesli Kay to As the World Turns , Eva LaRue to All My Children , A Martinez to Santa Barbara, and Alicia Leigh Willis to Another World .
